summary: RA per-site read + park page + schedule: 29 RV-only full-hookup 30 A sites, all 40 ft, 14 pull-through, no restrooms/showers, park store, $70 every night (2027 checked May and October), season 5/22-10/24 (2026), lottery for summer, 12-month window, pets only 9/14-10/31. AWH 'coastal dunes' kept; imagery says the front row is directly on the harbour mouth. Website to replace; phone to add.
flags: Waterfront (--AWH 'coastal dunes', not changed; disagreement reported): the camping is a paved/gravel lot, not dunes. RA tags sites 001-014 'Riverfront' and 015-016 'Oceanfront'. The front row (001 42.89772,-70.81520 to 014 42.89737,-70.81287) sits ~15-25 m from the riprap edge of the Hampton River mouth / Hampton Harbor inlet (~250 m wide, open to the Atlantic), over open ground with nothing between but the seawall; 015/016 (42.89736,-70.81270) face the harbour mouth beach. On these facts the front row earns waterfront (oceanfront/inlet) outright, a stronger call than 'coastal dunes'. Sold nightly through RA.

Price: $70 a night for every site, every date checked (May and October 2027); summer peak also $70. Over $50, but the price gate is a private-park rule and this is a state park; no gateway within 40 km (Boston 63 km). No dry-camping sites found on RA despite the rate table's $40 line. Reported for AWH.

Policy-row contradiction: RA's RV/Trailer booking window here is 12 months ('can be made up to 12 Month(s) in advance'), not the state's 11 months. Also the state row's 65+ resident discount excludes Hampton Beach (RA bulletin).
Facilities: 'No restroom or shower facilities are available at the campground' and 'No cassette toilets allowed' - a rig needs its own bathroom.
Pin 42.8983,-70.8144 sits in the grass field ~90 m NNW of the site rows' centre (42.89756,-70.81389); no move needed.
